notes.content:

notes.title: Devtycoon Beta v0.0.3
notes.content:
Fixed a couple of beta related bugs.

[olist]
[*] Fixed language-related issues that prevented texts from loading correctly the first time the game is launched.
[*] Fixed a couple of incorrect texts.
[/olist]

notes.title: Devtycoon Beta v0.0.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
The following points have been fixed::

[olist]
[*] Fixed bugs that prevented characters from using some items after being moved or rotated.

[*] Leveling up projects when working as a freelancer has been done, budgets are more realistic and are now more profitable.

[*] Added a notification when new projects are published when working as a freelancer

[*] Working speed is now correctly affected depending on the computer the character is working with.
[/olist]
